name: The Growing Sunset
source:
After centuries of stagnation, things are finally changing. The god himself became very involved four years ago, and nothing has been the same since.  The church's first-ever prophet has recently contacted you for help in building a chapel.

And, oh boy, do they need your help; with more than just constructing a building, it seems.

[From [url=https://wornout-mushroom.itch.io/the-growing-sunset]itch.io[/url]]
